summary: Iter 9 cosmetic hardening verified. (a) printable.js still opens blob: URL popup containing 'X REPORT · MID-SHIFT' and 'TOTAL REVENUE' from Shift page btn-x-report. (b) grep of /app/frontend/src returns ZERO occurrences of 'document.write'. (c) Backend /api/reports/summary returns identical shape (total_revenue, total_orders, avg_ticket, by_hour[{hour,revenue}], by_category, by_payment, by_staff) and revenue delta after paying a fresh order == order total. (d) Core order+pay sanity for 'octopus' and 'fps_qr' methods → status=paid. (e) /api/kds still exposes product_id per ticket. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: printable.js is XSS-safe (Blob URL + window.open), no direct DOM writes.
reports_summary refactor is a pure cosmetic rename (h → hour) and materialisation of sorted() into hour_items/cat_items/staff_items — response contract preserved.
server.py is 932 lines — still within acceptable single-module range but approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting into routers when next iterating.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_iter9 orders and paid them via cash/octopus/fps_qr for revenue-delta assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter9_reports.py can be reused. Note: /api/orders/{id}/pay requires top-level 'method' AND 'amount' fields in payload (not just splits) — Pydantic model PaymentIn enforces this.
